crew.overview: The story of American showman P.T. Barnum, founder of the circus that became the famous traveling Ringling Bros. and Barnum & Bailey Circus.
crew.title: The Greatest Showman

details.biography: Jon Poll is an American film director, editor and producer, best known for his directorial debut with the 2007 film Charlie Bartlett. Poll is the one of three sons of the late film producer, Martin Poll. He graduated from the University of Southern California's film school in 1981 before becoming a film editor.
details.name: Jon Poll
